en.headline: Two injured in three-car crash on Tai Po Ting Kok Road after wrong-way vehicle
en.dek: A private car travelling the wrong way collided head-on with another near Lei Pik Shan early Sunday, causing a third vehicle to hit the rear; two drivers were taken to hospital.
body: Two men were injured in a three-vehicle collision on Ting Kok Road in Tai Po in the early hours of Sunday, after a private car was reported to have driven against the flow of traffic.

The incident occurred around 1am near the Lei Pik Shan area. According to reports, a private car travelling towards Tai Mei Tuk encountered an oncoming vehicle that had crossed onto the opposite lane. The vehicles collided head-on, and a following private car then struck the rear of the vehicle ahead.

A 38-year-old male driver of the wrong-way car suffered chest and leg injuries and was taken to Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital. The 57-year-old male driver of the car that was hit head-on sustained neck, chest and leg injuries and was also taken to hospital. A third driver was not injured.

The 38-year-old driver reportedly left the scene briefly before later contacting police, saying he had lost consciousness after the crash. Police have classified the case as a traffic accident involving injuries and leaving the scene, and are investigating. No one has been arrested.

zh.headline: 大埔汀角路三車相撞兩人受傷 有司機疑逆線行駛
zh.dek: 周日凌晨約1時，大埔汀角路近犁壁山有私家車疑逆線行駛，與對向車輛迎頭相撞，尾隨車輛再撞前車車尾，兩名司機受傷送院。
body: 大埔汀角路周日凌晨發生三車相撞意外，造成兩人受傷，當中一輛私家車被指逆線行駛。
意外約於凌晨1時發生在犁壁山一帶。據報，一輛私家車沿汀角路往大美督方向行駛時，遇上疑逆線而來的車輛，兩車迎頭相撞，車頭冒煙；尾隨的另一輛私家車收刹不及，撞向前車車尾。
涉嫌逆線的38歲男司機胸口及腳部受傷，被送往雅麗氏何妙齡那打素醫院治理。被迎頭撞及的57歲男司機則頸部、胸口及腳部受傷，同樣送院。第三名司機沒有受傷。
消息指，逆線司機意外後一度離開現場，其後向警方報案，聲稱意外後失去意識。警方將案件列作交通意外有人受傷及不顧而去，正調查事件經過，暫未有人被捕。
